headline: Spain cruise, Portugal squeak by, and Chris gets a proper duffing
text: Recent results were a mixed bag: Spain (Grandad) were the big winners with a 3-0 stroll, while Portugal (Jack) edged Croatia (Henry) 2-1 and USA (Vicki) beat Bosnia & Herzegovina (Chris) 2-0. That leaves Grandad, Jack and Vicki smiling; Henry and Chris are having a rather grim time of it. Overall, Max stays top of the table on 26 points, with Grandad best of the rest on 20. At the bottom, Sofia is still propping up the sweepstake on 9 points. A tidy little afternoon for some, a right mess for others.
